# THE SIGNAL — 1Commerce LLC

> Weekly dispatches, fieldnotes, and daily briefs from a solo founder building commerce infrastructure in Canby, Oregon (Portland metro). Proof-first systems, AI agents, Shopify development, and build-in-public publishing since 2025.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://1commercesolutions.com/): Landing page with Cathedral Framework overview, verified builds index, and latest dispatch.
- [About](https://1commercesolutions.com/about/): Founder Keith's background, the Cathedral Principle (Foundation → Revenue → Systems → Scale), and the 1Commerce LLC mission.
- [Archive](https://1commercesolutions.com/archive/): Complete archive of weekly Signal transmissions — dispatches №001 through №021.
- [Daily](https://1commercesolutions.com/daily/): Daily operating briefs on commerce systems, AI agents, SEO discipline, and proof-first execution.
- [Fieldnotes](https://1commercesolutions.com/fieldnotes/): Long-form strategy notes, system specs, build logs, and operating plans published most Saturdays.
- [Builds](https://1commercesolutions.com/builds/): Verified production deployments — 6+ live commerce systems with architecture notes.
- [News](https://1commercesolutions.com/news/): Real-time operator-curated tech and commerce news via RSS aggregation.
- [Videos](https://1commercesolutions.com/videos/): Founder video transmissions, system architecture walkthroughs, and build-in-public dispatches.

## About 1Commerce LLC

1Commerce LLC is a solo founder operation based in Canby, Oregon (Clackamas County, Portland metro area). Keith builds commerce infrastructure — headless storefronts, AI agent pipelines, MCP servers, Shopify CI/CD systems, and affiliate backends — under the Cathedral Principle: build the foundation first, then revenue, then systems, then scale.

**Active systems in production:**
- UnifyOne — AI commerce intelligence layer with MCP endpoint
- Precision Core — authentication and operations backbone
- Forged American — headless Next.js storefront (Netlify + Stripe)
- Torqued Affiliates — Shopify affiliate backend with webhook processing
- PACER — distressed domain discovery and RWA monetization pipeline
- 1Commerce MCP Server — Model Context Protocol surface for store, product, order, and AI tooling

**The Signal** is the public publishing layer: weekly dispatches, daily briefs, fieldnotes, and a build-in-public record of every system shipped.
